feedback.end: A pilgrimage is a religious journey. If they were ill, wealthy Greeks would travel to temples built in honour of gods of healing.

instruction.text: This is an ancient Greek temple of healing. Select the correct feature.

feedback.finish: The Greeks believed that diseases were punishments from angry Gods, so they would sacrifice animals to try and please them.
The bigger and more valuable an animal was, the better the sacrifice!

instruction.text: Select the other features of healing temples.

feedback.end: Patients would use the spa to relax and to clean themselves.
A healthy diet was important for patients’ bodies to recover from illness.
While at the temple, priests would interpret a patient’s dreams to make plans for treatment.
Patients had to give the temple an offering as payment and to please the god whose temple it was. Often this was money, but it could also be food or prayer.

atoms.b: This is Hippocrates, a famous Greek ((++doctor dog_trainer)). He was one of the first to say that diseases came from ((++natural_causes nice_weather)) instead of the gods.
He focused on treating people’s symptoms rather than just ((++praying partying)) for them.
Hippocrates also focused on ((++natural nasty)) cures. He understood that ill people need rest and a clean environment so that their bodies can get better by themselves.
